# blockmodels: Latent and Stochastic Block Model Estimation by a 'V-EM' Algorithm

Latent and Stochastic Block Model estimation by a Variational EM algorithm. Various probability distribution are provided (Bernoulli, Poisson...), with or without covariates.

## Installation

The stable version of blockmodels can be installed from CRAN with:

```r
install.packages("blockmodels")
```

The development version can be installed from [GitHub](https://github.com/GrossSBM/blockmodels) with:

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("GrossSBM/blockmodels")
```

## Documentation

The package documentation is available on [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=blockmodels) and (will be) on [GitHub](https://grosssbm.github.io/blockmodels/).
